'''Hazar Yupcavage''' served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and as a [[Regional Director]] of the [[Imperial Corrections Service]].<ref name="Messages" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Death Troopers]]''&mdash;which all messages featured in ''[[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge]]'' were written during&mdash;to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> corrections service [[Warden/Legends|warden]] [[Bissley Kloth]] of the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] wrote a message to inform Yupcavage of a situation aboard the barge. The warden detailed ''Purge's'' [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] failing and the subsequent infection of most [[Prisoner/Legends|inmates]] and staff aboard the barge with a [[Disease/Legends|virus]]<ref name="Messages" /> that unbeknowngst to Kloth, was [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]].<ref name="Death">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>

Kloth reported the only information he could gather from the infected crew was the word "Blackwing"&mdash;the project's codename. The warden then informed Yupcavage that<ref name="Messages" /> he<ref name="Death" /> had followed the standard operating procedure and put ''Purge'' under quarentine. Kloth thanked Yupcavage for their understanding in advance. The message was later recovered and released in the interest of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] scholarship when ''Purge'' was discovered in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Messages" /> after the virus [[Death/Legends|killed]] and [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] the majority of ''Purge''{{'s}} crew and inmates.<ref name="Death" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hazar Yupcavage was mentioned in a message<ref name="Messages" /> written by [[Joe Schreiber]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> and posted to [http://www.rebelscum.com Rebelscum.com] on [[September 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="Messages" /> The message was among [[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge|several]] that were distributed across various official and unofficial ''[[Star Wars]]'' websites as promotion for Schreiber's novel ''[[Death Troopers]]''<ref name="TERC" /> released on [[October 13]] of that same year.<ref name="Board">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=8175#17541629|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|author=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2009-02-12|time=12:58 PM|quote=Del Rey has decided to publish DEATHTROOPERS as a hardcover instead of a paperback, and it's now coming out October 13th.}}</ref>
